defects.claim_says: the order sets a report date ('report on or before October 18th, 1966 for the Evendale dispute and as soon as possible for any other strike')
defects.source_says: The order's words are "With respect to the dispute giving rise to the strike at Evendale, Ohio, plant it shall report on or before October 18th, 1966, and with respect to the dispute or disputes resulting in any other such strike, it shall report as soon as possible." The quoted string does not occur in the order; it is a paraphrase presented in quotation marks.

defects.claim_says: the order sets a report date ('report on or before March 8, 1967')
defects.source_says: The order's words are "The Board shall report to the President m accordance with the provisions of Section 206 of such Act on or before March 8, 1967." The quoted string does not occur in the order; it is a paraphrase presented in quotation marks.

defects.claim_says: the standstill is a spent fact whose date no held source fixes; no held reviewed source establishes the dates on which the board reported or the standstill ran out; later_events: []
defects.source_says: A held text, jobs/source-ladder/output/texts/queue_EO_11343_Emergency_Board_report_to_the_President_on_the_Long_Island_Rail_Road_disputes_EO_1134_fc0b3e43ef.txt (NMB PEB-170-Report.pdf, sha256 5a7a3638...; on disk before the packet was prepared), is the Report to the President by Emergency Board No. 170 appointed by EO 11343, with a transmittal dated 'May 12, 1967' (Washington, D.C.). The Cruden by-number scan returns it. The 2026-10-21 report-deadline ruling requires the report date and standstill end to be recorded as later_events with a 'functionally spent on <date>' note.

defects.claim_says: Bounded search read for this order: ... and a full read of EO 12553 (held FR text, 33,227 characters).
defects.source_says: EO 12553 does not name EO 11355; the ending instrument is EO 12919 section 904(a)(6) (59 FR 29525) and the later event is EO 12107. The search account names the wrong instrument as the full read.

defects.claim_says: the order sets a report date ('report on or before October 2, 1968')
defects.source_says: The order's words are "The Board shall report to the President in accordance with the provisions of Section 206 o f such Act on or before October 2, 1968." The quoted string does not occur in the order; it is a paraphrase presented in quotation marks.

defects.claim_says: the pre-1981 text of 10 U.S.C. 5711(b) and 6386(c), which the order cites as its authority, is not held
defects.source_says: EO 11436 cites only 'section 6386 (c) of title 10 of the United States Code'; section 5711(b) is cited by EO 11284, not by this order. The claim's own research_rationale correctly says the order cites section 6386(c).

defects.field: research_rationale, member checks (scope_check, independent_command_check) and savings_residuals.reason
defects.claim_says: the report command and standstill are spent facts; the order consists of 'creation of the board, report command, standstill'; 'EO 12095 itself contains only the board's creation, report command and standstill'
defects.source_says: The held text of EO 12095 has only 1-101 (Establishment of Board) and 1-102 (Report); it has no standstill or maintaining-conditions command. The claim's own judgment_reason lists only those two commands, so the claim contradicts itself.

defects.claim_says: No instrument other than EO 12379 is shown to have ended this order or its parent before 1982-08-17; no unnamed earlier candidate is disclosed
defects.source_says: The clause's whole content adds two officials, the Director of the Community Services Administration and the Chairman of the Council on Wage and Price Stability. A held source, jobs/ofr-codification-1989/output/texts/EO_12344.txt (OFR editorial note), states that the Community Services Administration was abolished by Pub. L. 97-35 (1981). The 2026-10-21 unnamed-instruments ruling requires every claim to record such an unnamed event as a disclosed earlier candidate end, with its source pinned where held. The claim omits it and does not examine whether the Council on Wage and Price Stability still existed in 1982. If both offices had ceased, nothing in the order still operated before EO 12379.

defects.claim_says: [] (empty), while the judgment_reason states that EO 12429 (1983-06-28), EO 12447 (1983-10-27) and EO 12455 (1983-12-29) each rewrite the section 4(b) sentence and 'are later events that change the date' and the rationale says they are 'later events recorded in the reasons'
defects.source_says: The owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments requires each such amendment to be a later_event recording the clause text before and after; PRODUCTION_ROUTE.md requires each extension order to be a later event with its own date and quote; CLAIM_SCHEMA requires every later event to carry effective date, actor, mechanism and source. EO_12429.txt, EO_12447.txt and EO_12455.txt each restate section 4(b) ('terminate on October 30,1983', 'December 31, 1983', 'January 31,1984', each 'unless sooner extended'). The claim names three later events but records none with a source, so the lifecycle is internally inconsistent and incomplete; the same batch records the analogous EO 13032 amendment as a later_event for EO 12987.

defects.claim_says: [] (empty), while the judgment_reason states that EO 12447 (signed 1983-10-27, date 1983-12-31) and EO 12455 (signed 1983-12-29, date 1984-01-31) rewrote the same sentence and 'are later events that change the date'
defects.source_says: EO_12447.txt and EO_12455.txt each restate section 4(b) of EO 12369 'to read' with the new termination date, replacing the sentence this order installed. Under the 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert ruling, PRODUCTION_ROUTE.md (extension orders are later events with their own date and quote) and CLAIM_SCHEMA (each later event needs date, actor, mechanism, source), both amendments must be recorded as later_events with sources and before-and-after text; the claim names them as later events but records none.

defects.claim_says: Section 4(a) assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for the Advisory Committee 'to another official'
defects.source_says: EO_12891.txt section 4(a): those functions 'shall be performed by the Human Radiation Interagency Working Group', a multi-agency body, in accordance with GSA guidelines; no single official receives them.

defects.claim_says: Category (2) of section 2(a) covers experiments involving intentional environmental releases of radiation (nothing else described)
defects.source_says: The clause text also contains the separate command that the Committee 'shall also provide advice, information, and recommendations on the following experiments', with items (1) the Green Run test and (2) the Oak Ridge field experiments; the reason omits that command.

defects.claim_says: the captured span 'also runs across a printed page boundary into the next page header'
defects.source_says: The span continues past the header into the operative paragraph 'The Advisory Committee shall review experiments conducted from 1944 to May 30, 1974' with the sampling and further-inquiry rules for later experiments; the reason describes this command as header spillover and the claim's reasons nowhere describe it. Items (3) and (5) of the specific-experiments list are also mislabelled as 'Category (3)' and 'Category (5)' of the section 2(a) definition, which has only two categories.
